purpose: Assess whether cheaper MTP drafts (truncated draft-vocab head / int8 drafter) transfer to the Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S gfx1151 topline.

model.geometry: dense H5120, FFN17408, 64 target blocks + NextN

finding.external_premise: external stack made 3 drafts pay off by cutting per-draft cost: int8 drafter module + 40k-token truncated draft-vocab head (~1ms vs ~3ms per draft).
finding.source: retained exact B3 topline artifact benchmarks/results/2026-08-17-gfx1151-qwen38-27b-q4ks-exact-native-b3.json (decode wall 9.920s; proposal 0.206s; target_verify 9.663s)

resident_runner_draft_lmhead_share.source: 2026-07-01 gguf-mtp-draft-rocprof llama-compat b2 (Qwen3.6-35B-MoE resident runner rocprof)

finding.topline_draft_path: Qwen35GGUFNextNExecutor / Qwen35GGUFNextNDraftProvider (dense NextN executor) via scripts/qwen36_dense_gguf_suite.py; uses proposal_top1_exact_bf16 over full vocab 248320; NO vocab cap exposed
finding.resident_draft_path: Qwen35GGUFResidentMTPDraftRunner with vocab_cap built-in (default 32768; retained cap=65536 for Qwen3.6-PARO); Qwen3.8 _new_mtp_draft_runner passes full vocab 248320
finding.mechanism_detail: mtp_draft_vocab_cap / vocab_cap in Qwen35GGUFResidentMTPDraftRunner and draft_vocab_cap in kernels/hip_gfx1100/speculative/mtp_nextn.py shared_head_logits

economics.ceiling_from_truncated_head_only_percent: well under 1 (draft lm_head is ~57% of a ~2% draft stage)
economics.acceptance_risk: a truncated draft-vocab head changes which tokens the draft can propose; risk of acceptance-rate loss, which would increase target_forward_rows (the 97.4% verify term), offsetting the draft savings
economics.concurrency_note: external material win was concurrency via cheaper per-request state, not c=1 draft speed; same as R2 fp16-state finding

decision: Do not invest in cheaper MTP drafts for the c=1 Qwen3.8 Q4_K_S gfx1151 topline. The draft/proposal stage is only ~2% of decode wall (target verify is 97.4%); even a fully-free draft buys ~2%, and a truncated draft-vocab head recovers well under 1% while carrying acceptance-rate risk that could inflate the dominant verify term. The truncated-head mechanism already exists (vocab_cap / mtp_draft_vocab_cap) and is retained at cap=65536 for Qwen3.6-PARO, but wiring it into the Qwen3.8 dense NextN path is not worth it at c=1. Revisit only if a multi-request / concurrency target is adopted where the draft share grows.
